contract.purpose: Keep translated README files MAGRA-first while preserving Reasonix only as compatibility or upstream attribution.
contract.scope: Chinese and Japanese README overview, install commands, feature summary, compatibility aliases, and upstream attribution.

interfaces.interface-1: README.zh-CN.md MAGRA install and usage sections
interfaces.interface-2: README.ja-JP.md MAGRA install and usage sections

invariants.invariant-1: Localized primary install examples use `magra` and the MAGRA GitHub installer.
invariants.invariant-2: No localized README presents `reasonix` as the primary product or primary install path.
invariants.invariant-3: Reasonix mentions are limited to compatibility aliases, base runtime, migration, or upstream attribution.
